# noma documentation

> noma (noma.xyz) is a prediction market aggregator. This is the documentation site at docs.noma.xyz.

## Documentation structure

- Getting Started: /index, /quickstart, /why-noma, /how-prediction-markets-work
- Predict: /predict/overview, /predict/placing-a-trade, /predict/managing-orders, /predict/portfolio, /predict/five-minute-markets
- How Noma Works: /predict/providers, /predict/best-execution, /predict/cross-provider-matching, /predict/discovery
- Identity & Rewards: /social/noma-id, /social/leaderboards, /social/badges, /social/pulses, /rewards/overview, /rewards/multipliers
- Funds: /funds/overview, /funds/becoming-a-manager
- Wallet & Deposits: /wallet/setup, /wallet/deposits

- Supported Assets: /predict/supported-assets
- Collections: /predict/collections

## What noma does

noma aggregates prediction markets from Polymarket (decentralized, Polygon), Kalshi (CFTC-regulated, Solana via DFlow), and Limitless Exchange (decentralized, Base) into one interface. Zero trading fees, best-price routing across all three providers, embedded wallets, and a portable identity (Noma ID) with leaderboards, badges, and streaks. Personalized market discovery powered by social graph signals, vector similarity, and trading history.
